meaning.taglish: Isang experience na hindi madaling makalimutan.

check.explanation: Memorable: Worth remembering. Example: Our family vacation was memorable.
check.hint: Notice the meaning in this example: Our family vacation was memorable.

explanation.en: Memorable describes something that stays in your memory.
explanation.taglish: Ang memorable ay karanasang tumatatak sa isip.

meaning.en: To connect a new story with your own memory.
meaning.taglish: Kapag may naalala kang related na story, puwede mong sabihin ito.
meaning.fil: Pagkonekta ng narinig sa sarili mong alaala.

examples.work: That reminds me of our trip last year.
examples.everyday: That reminds me of our family picnic.

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.text: We took a long road trip last weekend.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That reminds me of our trip last year.

check.prompt: What does 'That reminds me of' introduce?
check.explanation: To connect a new story with your own memory. Example: That reminds me of our trip last year.
check.hint: Read the example: That reminds me of our trip last year.

grammarTip.explanation: Use 'That reminds me of + a person, thing, or event': 'That reminds me of our trip.' Then tell what happened using past-tense verbs.

speaking.scenario: A friend describes a trip. Share a related memory and explain why it stayed with you.
hints: That reminds me of a funny moment from last year.
speaking.oneMinuteGoal: Describe the situation, your main point, and one example.
speaking.twoMinuteGoal: Add a reason, another example, and a clear conclusion.
speaking.modelResponse: That reminds me of a family trip we took years ago. We got lost on the way, but we discovered a beautiful little town. We still laugh about that day whenever we get together.
selfReview: I answered the situation with a clear main message.
I included the detail or question the listener needs.
I chose one sentence to improve or practice again.
preparationQuestions: What main point do you want to share?

durationGuidance.en: One and two minutes are optional practice targets, not minimums. A shorter complete message counts. Start with two or three sentences, then add detail if useful.
durationGuidance.taglish: Optional targets lang ang isa o dalawang minuto. Puwedeng mas maikli basta malinaw ang mensahe. Magsimula sa dalawa o tatlong pangungusap.
durationGuidance.fil: Gabay lamang ang isa o dalawang minuto, hindi kailangang abutin. Sapat ang mas maikling sagot kung malinaw ang mensahe.

speaking.modelResponseNote: This is one short example, not a script to memorize or a timed one-minute answer. Your details and wording may differ.

prompt.en: Before speaking, try to recall a useful expression from Day 14. Use it if it fits today's situation; no extra recording is needed.
prompt.taglish: Bago magsalita, subukang alalahanin ang isang expression sa Day 14. Gamitin kung bagay sa situation today; hindi kailangan ng dagdag na recording.
prompt.fil: Bago magsalita, alalahanin ang isang pahayag mula sa Araw 14. Gamitin kung angkop; hindi kailangan ng dagdag na rekording.
